rules.name: Ambush Tactics
rules.text: When deployed on the table, these units may start the game on Ambush. (also page 24 AoIJ)

rules.name: Assault
rules.text: This weapon suffers no penalty 'to hit' when moving and shooting. In addition, infantry models armed with an assault weapon count as having the Tough Fighters special rule (Tough Fighters: When a model with this special rule fails to damage in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can re-roll the failed rolls to damage)

rules.name: Behind enemy lines
rules.text: When outflanking as described on page 172, unit ignores the -1 modifier to the order test for coming onto the table.

rules.name: Bicycles
rules.text: When moving on roads, they double their Run move to 24" (cannot be used to Assault). The first time they receive any order other than Run, or if they receive a Pin marker, they dismount and abandon their bicycles for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Commandos (Heavy Weapons)
rules.text: Commando machine gun teams, mortar teams, anti-tank teams, and flamethrower teams can fire any small arms they carry, if the team is not firing the main weapon.

rules.name: Fieldcraft (including light artillery)
rules.text: (v3 page 120) Treat rough ground as open ground instead. (v3 page 22 AoI) (AoI and AoGB Chindits: this applies to light howitzers and light anti-tank guns too, but not to other artillery units).

rules.name: Independent
rules.text: If a Commando subsection loses its NCO, roll a die. On a roll of 3 or more, another model within the unit is immediately selected to act as the unit's NCO. On the roll of 1 or 2, treat the subsection as having lost it's NCO as normal.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.text: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn (as long as the Intelligence Officer is on the table), the Officer may act on intelligence gathered about the enemy force before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6, a Veteran Officer receives a +1 modifier on the roll, an Inexperienced one receives a -1 modifier. On a 4+, the player using this ability may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players are doing this in the same turn and both succeed in this roll, the results cancel out and the dice is randomly drawn, as normal. Only one Officer in the entire force may have Intelligence training.

rules.name: Iron Discipline
rules.text: May remove 2 pin markers rather than the usual 1 if an order test is passed.

rules.name: Stubborn
rules.text: If forced to take a morale check, they ignore negative morale modifiers from pin markers. Remember that order tests are not morale checks, and are therefore modified as normal.

rules.name: Tank hunters
rules.text: If a tank hunter unit wins an assault and scores damage against an armoured vehicle, the effect is resolved on the Damage Result table as for a normal anti-tank penetration rather than as for superficial damage. In addition, these troops don't suffer from the Tank Fear rule when assaulting fully-enclosed armoured vehicles.

rules.name: Tough Fighters
rules.text: When a model with this special rule fails to damage in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can re-roll the failed rolls to damage.

rules.name: Who Dares Wins! (SAS)
rules.text: Count as Fanatics except they do not lose this rule when reduced to a single man.

armyRules.name: Fix Bayonets!
armyRules.text: For every three models (irrespective of what armament they carry) in your unit involved in close quarters you may add an additional die when rolling to damage. These attacks are assumed to come from any of the models in the unit. For example, four models would add one additional die.

armyRules.name: Artillery Support
armyRules.text: When rolling on the Artillery Barrage Table or the Smoke Barrage Table, roll two dice and pick the highest result.

armyRules.name: Come on, Lads!
armyRules.text: British Platoon and Company Commanders morale bonus is increased by 1, but any cover save they and the men in their unit receive is reduced by 1. (October 2025 errata)

rules.name: Fixed
rules.text: When ordered to Fire, fixed weapons can only target an enemy unit that lies at least partially within their front arc (i.e. within an angle of 45 degrees to each side of their barrel). Targets outside of this arc cannot be shot at with a Fire order. When ordered to Advance, fixed weapons do not move from their position, but can instead be rotated on the spot to face any direction, and can then fire suffering the normal -1 to hit for 'fire on the move'. When ordered to Run, fixed weapons that are carried and crewed by infantry teams move the normal 12" over open ground or 6" over rough ground, obstacles, etc. Fixed weapon units can never assault other units. If assaulted by an enemy, the gun itself is ignored and the crew models are assaulted as normal. Exceptions for artillery fixed weapons are listed in the Artillery section on page 123 (Any artillery piece defined as light or medium can be moved by the crew with a Run order, as normal for fixed weapons - except that these units can only move 6" rather than 12" with a Run order. Heavy and super-heavy anti-tank guns and heavy howitzers, as well as any lighter gun whose crew is reduced to a single man, cannot be moved by their crew with a Run order (though they may be rotated by way of an Advance order, as normal for fixed weapons). They can only be moved by means of a tow. Page 125 note: 'platform-mounted', 'rotating platform' or 'turntable' guns can rotate for free (no -1 movement penalty).

Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

armyRules.name: Fix Bayonets!
armyRules.text: For every three models (irrespective of what armament they carry) in your unit involved in close quarters you may add an additional die when rolling to damage. These attacks are assumed to come from any of the models in the unit. For example, four models would add one additional die.

armyRules.name: Artillery Support
armyRules.text: When rolling on the Artillery Barrage Table or the Smoke Barrage Table, roll two dice and pick the highest result.

armyRules.name: Come on, Lads!
armyRules.text: British Platoon and Company Commanders morale bonus is increased by 1, but any cover save they and the men in their unit receive is reduced by 1. (October 2025 errata)

rules.text: - cannot hit targets within their minimum range, measured from the centre the weapon itself. Units hit by indirect file receive no cover saves of any kind.
